'''Curtis Praskac''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 DragonCon Open]] on 30 June 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court, scum, alien deck]], according to Bill Gordon's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d966">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-6-30-2000d966/ dragoncon-6-30-2000], DeckTech (Bill "BRay" Gordon, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-6-30-2000d966/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
